hits.page: Kaori Sakamoto wins 4th world figure skating title before retirement

hits.text: Kaori Sakamoto finished in second place after missing one of her jumps, while Ami Nakai had errors with some of her jumps, but the high difficulty level of her routine allowed her to win the bronze medal. Sakamoto experienced an awkward landing on her triple flip, which forced her to forego the triple toe loop she had planned in combination. The point value of that missing toe loop was more than the 1.89-point difference that separated Sakamoto from Liu. Sakamoto had won the bronze medal at the 2022 Winter Olympics, a win that she described as a "miracle" considering the circumstances of the women's event in 2022, where the three Russian skaters had been expected to sweep the podium; however, she added, "I have a better medal [now].... However, I feel very frustrated and disappointed because I have tried so hard for the past four years." Mone Chiba delivered a solid performance and finished in fourth place.
